reason: Net-additive defect fix: GitOps.commit now unstages any gitlink the staged change set newly introduces (an embedded git repo would otherwise ride a WIP commit to the merge lane) and stages with --ignore-errors so one commit-less embedded repo can no longer abort staging and silently drop the real WIP; the diff parser lives in staged_gitlinks.py, git_ops.py gains only the unstage-and-warn seam and its docstring
